dataset.name: Olist Brazilian E-Commerce
dataset.description: An anonymized relational Brazilian e-commerce dataset covering orders, customers, sellers, products, payments, reviews, and geolocation from 2016 to 2018.

files.description: Customer identifiers and customer location fields.
Item-level order, seller, product, price, and freight records.
Payment method, installment, and payment value records.
Order review scores, comments, and timestamps.
